text:
Luca (Contractor): Hi team — I'm filing expenses for a 3-day trip to Berlin for a client workshop. I used a mix of company card and cash. Quick Q: do contractors get per diem for meals or do I need to submit actual receipts?
expense-bot: Reminder: Contractors: submit itemized receipts for meals unless a per diem agreement exists on your SOW.
Luca (Contractor): my SOW doesn't mention per diem. I have lots of small receipts (coffee, lunches). Some vendors only gave paper slips that are a bit faded. Can I still upload photos?
Elaine (Finance): Hi Luca — yes, photos are fine. We need legible merchant name, date, and amount. For faded paper slips, a short note in the expense form explaining the situation helps. We don't reimburse tip amounts above 20% without explanation.
Luca (Contractor): uploaded photos of 8 receipts + a diary note describing each (date, merchant, attendees). Total meals = EUR 172. Also paid EUR 40 cash for shared taxi, no receipt (driver gave change and no receipt).
Maya (Manager): I approve expenses for my contractors. Confirming I was on three of those meals (client dinners) and approve the taxi.
Elaine (Finance): For the taxi cash we need either a merchant receipt or a signed attestation from you and the contractor detailing route/date/time and amount. Maya — can you sign an attestation in the expense system?
Maya (Manager): signed attestation submitted.
expense-bot: Expense created: "Berlin workshop - Jun 2026" status: awaiting review. Link: https://expenses.internal/reports/EXP-2789
Elaine (Finance): Thanks. A few policy notes: 1) Currency conversions: we'll reimburse in USD using the corporate FX rate on the transaction date, expect slight rounding. 2) For faded receipts we may request additional verification if merchant name can't be read.
Luca (Contractor): merchant names are readable on 7/8, one receipt is a napkin-like note with amount only. I added a note saying it was a coffee at "Cafe Am Platz" and included a calendar invite attendee list.
Elaine (Finance): That's reasonable. I'll mark the napkin note as "accepted with manager attestation" and process the rest. Coding: PROJECT-CLIENTX. ETA payment 5-7 biz days.
Luca (Contractor): hugely appreciated, thanks. Will keep receipts digital next time.
Elaine (Finance): Thanks Luca — filing case FIN-2026-121 for audit trail. If any item is rejected we'll notify here.
